temptationgump.help.title: Temptations
temptationgump.help.body:
Command: [Temptations

Temptations will add or change basic gameplay mechanics for your character. You may be tempted by the powerful benefits, but you should take note of the significant drawbacks. Once you've been tempted, you may never go back. Choose wisely.
temptationgump.name.deathwish: It's dangerous to go alone! Take this.
temptationgump.desc.i_can_take_it:
+ You do 10% more damage
x You take 20% more damage
temptationgump.desc.strongest_avenger:
+ You learn how to wear pants
x Enemies cast spells faster
temptationgump.desc.famine:
+ Your stat and skill gain rate is impacted by your Hunger
x Hunger and thirst decay twice as fast
temptationgump.desc.puzzle_master:
+ You learn how to solve puzzle boxes
x Reduced skill cap bonuses for Fugitives (+200) and Titan of Ether quest (+200)
x Magical attributes from monster racial bonuses now act as Minimums. Resist/Stat bonuses still stack.
temptationgump.puzzle.base: + You learn how to solve puzzle boxes
temptationgump.desc.deathwish:
+ You gain stats and skills faster
- An old sword
x You may never be resurrected
temptationgump.msg.avatar_unlock_require: An Avatar must unlock the Temptations system before using this command.
temptationgump.puzzle.info.intro: This temptation removes the need for integrating Stealing and Snooping into your template.
temptationgump.puzzle.info.skillcap:
Permanently reduced skill cap bonuses
- Fugitives begin with a +200 skill cap bonus, down from +300
- Titan of Ether quest completion grants +200 skill cap bonus, down from +500
temptationgump.puzzle.info.racial_exampl:
Monster racial bonuses
- Magical attribute type bonuses now act as Minimums instead of stacking with equipment
- Resist/Stat bonuses stack normally

Example:
- Your combined equipment bonuses
+1 Fire Resistance
+2% Damage Increase
+30 Luck
+4 Arms Lore
- Your monster racial bonuses provide
+5 Fire Resistance
+6% Damage Increase
+7 Luck
+8 Arms Lore
- Your total bonus values are
1 + 5 ... 6 Fire Resistance
Max(2%, 6%) ... 6% Damage Increase
Max(30, 7) ... 30 Luck
4 + 8 ... 12 Arms Lore
